assessment: This study has used striking live-cell super-resolution microscopy methods to demonstrate the direct relationship between integrin dependent F-actin/myosin arcs and transport of surface immunoglobulin-antigen clusters in B-cell synapses. The function of the F-actin arcs in signaling at limiting antigen levels where integrins are important is also demonstrated. In addition, this study has shown that both follicular and germinal center B cells utilize the F-actin arcs, suggesting that this machinery can operate in both initiation and affinity maturation phases of antibody-based adaptive immunity. The work will be of interests to immunologists, cell biologists, and biophysicists, and the data sets should be of future use in modeling the process.
